changes: Adapted event-driven cell and workbook parsing to shared crabxl types without Range materialization
Separated generic numeric row streaming from eager workbook strings/styles and formula machinery
Resolved OPC root/workbook/sheet relationships and normalized internal part URIs
Kept namespace and end-tag validation enabled and added bounded input per XML event
Added checked coordinate arithmetic, sparse row ordering, projection before decoding, reusable rows and owned batches
Unsupported selected features fail explicitly; numeric decoding rejects invalid and non-finite values instead of falling back to strings
Added contextual errors and resource budgets; retained no global or interpreter-exit resource registry
M2 boolean branch uses shared CellValue::Boolean and validates zero/nonzero signed decimal integer literals instead of calamine literal-string comparison; no per-cell heap payload added
M2 scalar port preserves integer/float lexemes and arbitrary decimal integer literals; adds plain inline/value text and literal errors with shared compact owned models and heap-payload accounting
Normal formula and optional typed cache decoding integrated with shared Formula; data-only projection and owned expression/cache accounting; non-normal metadata remains explicitly unsupported
Date-format classifier validates explicit date styles before writing; bounded bracket depth and coherent duration interpretation
Adapt selected reference/absolute-axis parsing into the runtime-independent core with checked arithmetic instead of wrapping offsets
Rewrite translation scanning to preserve single-quoted sheet qualifiers, doubled quoted strings and structured/external bracket context; do not rewrite reference-looking sheet/table names

Match public openpyxl formula-reference grammar and utility bounds separately from physical worksheet limits; out-of-range relative references return typed errors instead of silently retaining the original
Bound output capacity, share column formatting with core addresses, and prevalidate formula/range move staging before mutation; translated formulas drop old cached results
Full tokenizer/parser and dynamic spill syntax remain staged; translator origins/axis helpers require positive labels fitting u64
Refactor shared-string event flow into incremental namespace-aware parsing with relationship-resolved paths and actual-entry limits; never reserve from advertised uniqueCount

Replace eager Vec-only strings with shared Memory/Disk/Auto placement, bounded direct-slot decoded cache and complete disk-backed fixed-width index; actual over-budget data spills without sheet materialization
Retain unsupported extension entry IDs for projection; the subsequent shared rich codec adds default display-text projection and explicit typed metadata without changing ID order
Match pinned public shared-string x005F_ protection removal separately from unchanged inline literal spelling; do not import calamine general escape decoding
Share bounded XML character/entity accumulation across scalar and shared-string codecs

Replace dense shared-ID Vec allocation with a bounded sparse HashMap; use actual template-cell anchor rather than declared range.start; retain first definition and unresolved placeholders under public reference policy, with explicit stricter validation. Share typed array/data-table/range/flag models, bounded streaming attribute escaping and projected-template dependency scanning. Cache-only compatible mode avoids template retention. Dynamic cm/vm graphs and nonfinite scalars remain staged.

Follow-up nonfinite compatibility retains numeric-scientific overflow infinities; rejects invalid numeric tokens. Compatible writes use present empty numeric values, with explicit strict policy before row/overlay mutation. Former two deferred public overflow cases now pass.

Public-generated dynamic formula observations remove default cm/vm visible-value rejection, retain explicit Reject policy and report selected projections. Direct editor replacements remove only overwritten cell annotations while preserving opaque graph parts and other references; full typed graphs remain staged.

Integrate the locally bounded SST/shared-template ports with a joint managed policy pool: forecast template growth, lend/evict cache storage, transactionally spill existing Auto tables and charge retained model/batch capacities. Preserve forced Memory and source/temporary limits; direct API contracts and runtime/allocator/RSS boundaries remain explicit.

Compatible shared formula IDs use canonical numeric/literal/missing identities and shared immutable source strings; exact source grouping follows public openpyxl behavior instead of upstream u32-only IDs. Strict numeric validation stays available. Original source-key sharing and contextual tests add no reference implementation port.

Propagate typed I/O/validation/state errors instead of expect/unwrap or silently ignoring flushed rows
Encode one bounded reusable row before spooling; stream completed temporary worksheet files into ZIP; no whole-sheet XML buffer
Use owned temporary files with explicit finish/abort and all-resource cleanup; create next-sheet temporary resource before committing the state transition
Preserve exact integer literals and float lexical distinctions; text escapes XML and retains whitespace; reject unsupported OOXML escape-looking text instead of corrupting it
Finish uses caller-selected seekable output and may leave partial output on failure; no implicit workbook save on Drop
Adapt initial basic styles to a shared core model with deduplicated complete format IDs and bounded tables; advanced/named/theme styles remain M5
Adapt formula XML to typed optional caches, preserving missing/zero/false/text/error/date results without upstream fabricated default zero; shared/array/data-table metadata remains staged

Adapt Gregorian epoch/leapday conversion via foundational chrono with explicit fictitious-leapday epoch conversion errors, baseline millisecond calendar rounding and epoch-independent time/duration serials

M4 refactors the shared cell encoder to borrowed cloneable iterators for sparse model export and existing-cell replacement; editor/model logic is original implementation using foundational ZIP/XML APIs

Extend the adapted epoch/leapday conversion with original shared-core literal source representations preserving Gregorian identity and microseconds; imported numeric serials keep reference millisecond conversion, while literal epoch conversion uses original calendar fields

Integrate original public-probe-based ISO parsing/formatting and date-only literal types into the shared date model/encoder; optional ISO calendar/clock output remains separate from numeric elapsed duration storage; original-package date mutation remains guarded

Refactor style serialization from per-appearance duplicated component tables to canonical catalogs with builtin/custom format identity reuse, real phonetic font indices and streaming attribute escaping. Compatible zero/false alignment omission and complete default font/alignment identities follow pinned public observations; RetainExplicit is an independent Rust extension.

Port viewport/pane/selection composition into one canonical core model and borrowed XLSX codec; expand to baseline public attributes and source-ordered multiple views/selections, finite split validation, public freeze/load defaults, lazy owned-sheet metadata, bounded header reading and original-package overlays. Do not inherit upstream String attribute clones, zoom clamps or secondary-pane coordinates. Pure view edits retain formula caches/calculation chains; unknown source extensions reject typed replacement.

Port printing/page-break layout into shared optional typed models and borrowed codecs, extending public margins/options/setup fields and sparse break records. Preserve explicit false/default values and reference paper-dimension prefix spelling/manualBreakCount; reject nonfinite margins. Bound encoded/retained footer metadata and reserve its actual length for every row. Read through worksheet EOF/CRC without cell materialization; preserve unrelated sheet properties/header-footer/printer payloads via repeatable overlays and reject printer-ID graph mutations. Shared worksheet metadata validators replace duplicate view/printing attribute handling. Refactor component updates into prospective capacity accounting and moves; retain unrelated break ownership and reuse validated source metadata for subsequent updates without new upstream imports (ADR 0045).
